set.body: Parent release: bd-01KYSSZRDP783ZZ20EC7CK28M4. Owns INT-001 through INT-006 after the completed graph seam in bd-01KYST0RRTHES3YDJ6F1RBJN6Z. Companion implementation tracker: ScalaFIM bead bd-01KYT2FD73TC4X1SC10HB5NCW3. Audit every fixture and decoder against strict topology; preserve concrete witnesses; correct or explicitly orient inconsistent tetrahedron and spherical winding; replace bow-tie graph-star fixtures rather than weakening mesh laws. Introduce a temporary TriangleMesh facade over TriangleTopology plus SurfaceRealization with no second identity or adjacency authority; delegate surface data and maps to locus4s; use packed renderer coordinates with named normal weighting; rename graph shortest-path distance honestly. Exit with white, pial, inflated, and spherical realizations sharing one topology, thickness and labels as locus fields, one graph projection, packed renderer proof, and one strict or explicitly oriented FreeSurfer or GIFTI fixture. Current verified blocker: ScalaFIM surface baseline fails before this change with 88 image/locus compile errors during active image4s unification, and dirty edits overlap build.sbt and the compatibility files.
